title: UnDercontrol TimeSlot Resource
description: Schema for TimeSlot YAML resource files. A timeslot is one scheduled sitting on a task: the slot the calendar draws between start and end. A task can have many; deleting one leaves the task and its other timeslots alone. The API calls it a task slot (/tasks/{id}/slots, /task-slots/{id}).

task.description: The task this timeslot belongs to: a full task id or a unique prefix. Changing it on an existing timeslot moves the slot to that task, keeping its start and end.

start.description: When the slot starts. An absolute time: 2026-10-27T14:00 or 2026-10-27T14:00:00 (read in the applying machine's timezone), or RFC3339 with an offset (2026-10-27T14:00:00+08:00). A bare date or a relative word (today, -1d) is refused, so a file means the same instant whenever it is applied. Exported documents carry RFC3339 with the exporting machine's offset.

end.description: When the slot ends, exclusive; must be after start. Same forms as start. A slot may cross midnight.

then.description: Update (metadata.id given): write only what changes. A missing start or end keeps its current value; a changed task moves the slot first, then the interval is changed.

example.description:
Example timeslot YAML (create; omit metadata.id):

apiVersion: ud/v1
kind: TimeSlot
spec:
  task: ecff3bb8
  start: 2026-10-27T14:00
  end: 2026-10-27T16:00
